notes: Barcelona is one of Europe's top mobile/AA game hubs with 120+ studios. King (600 employees), Scopely, Rovio, Bandai Namco, Gameloft, Zynga/Socialpoint present. Premium pay vs small studios. Levels.fyi King median SWE €65K; Scopely SWE median €62K; Unity developers get ~10-15% less than SWE median.

Dominant vertical for Unity in Spain. Barcelona leads European mobile games scene. Most Glassdoor Unity salary reports come from this segment. Glassdoor avg Unity Dev Barcelona €35k (all levels combined); Glassdoor avg senior Unity €48k in Barcelona. Mobile studios pay below AA/AAA.

Spain has iGaming companies (Codere HQ Madrid; bet365/Betway offices in Barcelona) but is not a primary iGaming hub like CY/MT/GI. Some slot/live casino products built in Unity. High Palma Studios is one notable Barcelona-based iGaming Unity studio. Salaries above median market due to iGaming premium — estimated 15-20% above mobile studio rates.

Growing segment in Spain; Barcelona has XR startups and larger tech companies with AR/VR projects. Unity AR Foundation widely used. No dedicated Spain XR salary surveys found — estimated at slight premium (+5-10%) over general game dev mid-market due to niche skills demand.

Spain has active EdTech sector (e-learning platforms, simulation companies, universities) but Unity adoption is niche. Typically lower pay than gaming. Estimated ~10-15% below mid-market game dev. No direct Spain EdTech Unity salary data found.

Architecture/visualisation firms, defense contractors, training simulation companies. Some active in Spain (particularly in Madrid and Barcelona). Pay typically at or slightly above EdTech. Masterd.es notes automotive and industrial simulation pays more than game dev in Spain.

Spain is not a primary nearshore hub (unlike PL, RS, PT) but some IT outsourcing companies do hire Unity devs for client projects. Pay generally at or below local SME rates. Limited presence. Estimated based on Tecnoempleo general programmer ranges and outsourcing market discount.
